result: Pinned source establishes a minimal dispatch witness: handle_post computes use_session from per-request lifecycle classification before consulting session state. A non-initialize request carrying per-request protocol metadata that classifies to the stateless lifecycle enters the stateless branch even when legacy_session_mode is enabled. After header/meta validation, any request with a per-request protocolVersion sets negotiates_per_request=true and is passed to serve_negotiated_request_directly. That function reconstructs peer_info from the current request/header and calls serve_directly_with_ct, so this source path has no comparison against a prior initialize peer_info or SessionState before handler execution. Therefore, within this exact source path, a matching request-header/meta protocolVersion plus structurally valid changed clientCapabilities is not rejected merely for differing from a prior initialize context; transport rerouting to per-request stateless negotiation is the mechanism. Generic session/serve_inner behavior is not covered by this positive witness.
